author: Express News Service
title: Kerala flood relief volunteers mobilize emergency medicine network across Wayanad via Facebook
description: Civic volunteers in Wayanad, Kerala organized a rapid medicine delivery hub through local Facebook groups to assist landslide-affected families.
content: Decentralized community groups on Facebook mobilized hundreds of volunteers across Kerala within hours.

author: Buzz Desk
title: New Delhi heritage preservation group on Facebook uncovers forgotten Mughal stepwell
description: Archaeology enthusiasts collaborating on a Facebook community page discovered historic water structures near Mehrauli in New Delhi.
content: Citizens from across the national capital are visiting the restored site following the viral post.
